components.name: ConversationMaterials
components.summary: Manages owned operational attachments and explicit presentation preferences within one conversation.

props.name: token
props.meaning: In-memory credential supplied by the workspace, never retained in storage.

props.name: conversationId
props.meaning: Owned conversation; a new one is created before the first explicit save when absent.

props.name: source
props.meaning: ERP scope of new user-supplied material.

props.name: attachments
props.meaning: Server metadata only; never inline attachment bodies.

props.name: preferences
props.meaning: Explicitly saved language, detail and format; omitted values use automatic presentation.

props.name: disabled
props.meaning: Disables writes while access or conversation lifecycle prevents changes.

props.name: onCreated
props.meaning: Navigates to a newly persisted conversation before material is saved.

states: Selected file awaiting purpose and explicit approval
components.accessibility: The labeled plus trigger exposes an expanded state and opens a named modeless native popover. Keyboard focus enters its options, Escape and outside clicks dismiss it, and explicit close restores trigger focus. Named sections, shared labeled controls, an explicit approval checkbox and live status/alert messages retain the material workflow.
components.usage: Place the trigger inside the message composer. Its compact menu opens a file picker, existing attachment metadata or presentation settings. A viewport-bounded floating panel follows the composer without displacing the conversation; its portal sits outside the message form to prevent accidental submission from material fields. File selection remains local until explicit upload; replacing the file clears approval. Bounds, discard, retry IDs and dependent-reply removal remain intact. The server remains authoritative for ownership, limits and restricted-data policy.
